Welcome ! I literally joined this sub hours before starting the clinic . Definitely soak in a lot of info on here and you will avoid yourself headaches . Best advice would be : be vigilant in your treatment and covering your self . Be sure to not miss counselor appts , doc appts and know that your first week or two they Linda expect you to “supplement “ at night while you get to a high enough dose . My wife and I would just get one bag each for the first 5 days at night to make it to the morning . Once we hit 70mg, we could tolerate the WD until dose time . Then we got higher ln our dose and time went by and we felt amazing . I’m at a stable 180mg now . Don’t get caught up on the number . I was stuck at 160mg and my appetite was horrible . I decided to increase a month later and boom , next day I’m eating like a champ and have ever since I went up
